title: The Lyric Theater

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: From standard tables on the main floor to intimate booths on the second level, The Lyric accommodates groups of all sizes. Our lounge level offers a more relaxed setting with high tops, chairs, and booths closest to the bar. Our full bar features classic and specialty cocktails alongside a curated selection of local and craft beers. For live events, servers come directly to your table so the drinks never stop flowing. Meet Scott Arnold, The Lyric's private event coordinator. Scott works directly with you from inquiry to event day to make sure every detail is exactly as you imagined.
